goal: Align the Phase 4B allowed target surfaces with the Foundation's explicit QA and repository-hygiene requirements by authorizing bounded, non-shipping game/tests/** QA fixtures and their explicitly approved .gd.uid sidecars.
forbidden_changes: gameplay, art, asset, scene, script, collision, layout, or project-setting changes
broad testing framework or external-testing scope
final creative, product, art, production, or phase-closeout approval

verify.name: Brief authorizes bounded QA fixtures and UID sidecars
Foundation and implementation remain unchanged
verify.command: bash -lc 'changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- HALUCY_FOUNDATION.md CONTEXT.md game scripts art_candidates art_notes owner_reviews reviews learning_cards agents schemas | grep -v "^CONTEXT.md$" || true); test -z "$changed"'

acceptance_criteria: The Allowed Target Surfaces section explicitly permits game/tests/** only for bounded, non-shipping QA fixtures named by a later Phase 4B Work Package.
The brief explicitly allows a matching .gd.uid only when the same Work Package names it as a target and verification artifact.
The permission does not authorize gameplay code, broad test-framework, external testing, release automation, or .godot evidence.
HALUCY_FOUNDATION.md remains unchanged because its existing Phase 4B QA and explicit repository-hygiene principles already support the narrower brief correction.
No game, script, scene, asset, review, schema, profile, or lifecycle file changes; the pre-existing user-owned CONTEXT.md diff remains untouched and excluded from this package's scope assertion.
notes: The two-axis spec re-review found that WP-044's durable QA fixture was technically valid but its game/tests path was absent from the Phase 4B allowed-surface list. This bounded correction propagates the Foundation's existing QA/repo-hygiene decision into the phase brief without changing gameplay or product direction.
